family_reports.body: The family judicial system has actively participated in parental abuse and alienation, gone with the money, neglected the needs of my young child, and negatively impacted not just my immediate family, that includes siblings of the child this suit is affecting, but has out-poured into extended family and our community. Irreparable harm has been done to my baby girl’s psychological, physical, mental, and emotional well-being; the court system has allowed physical and mental abuse, emotional neglect, coercion and manipulation, and they do it with a smile on their face, to protect the parent who provides a socio-economic benefit to the lawyers, amicus attorney, GAL, and judge, and neglected to protect the child, as is their DUTY. They should all be behind bars.

Emotional distress for myself and our oldest child, secondary impact on child 2 and 3; taken away finances and security and energy to sustain building my post-divorce life. Stupidly expensive way to avoid being a man and god forbid having some accountability.
